output.customer: The record returned by the service

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only run when an invoice reaches this status. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: status

maxio_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is created in Maxio.

output.customer: The record returned by the service

maxio_new_event_trigger.description: Runs when something happens on your Maxio site, such as a signup, a payment or a state change.

output.billing_event: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only run for this kind of event. Leave empty for every event.
parameters.name: kind

maxio_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is created in Maxio.

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

maxio_new_subscription_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription is created in Maxio.

output.subscription: The record returned by the service

maxio_payment_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription's payment fails in Maxio, such as a declined card.

output.billing_event: The record returned by the service

maxio_payment_succeeded_trigger.description: Runs when Maxio collects a payment for a subscription.

output.billing_event: The record returned by the service

maxio_renewal_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a Maxio subscription fails to renew.

output.billing_event: The record returned by the service

maxio_subscription_canceled_trigger.description: Runs when a Maxio subscription is canceled.

output.subscription: The record returned by the service

maxio_subscription_state_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a Maxio subscription changes state, such as to active, past due, on hold or canceled.

output.subscription: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only run when a subscription reaches this state. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: state

maxio_subscription_updated_trigger.description: Runs when anything about a Maxio subscription changes, such as its product, billing date or state.

output.subscription: The record returned by the service
